evidence.note: After first training completion, reloaded checkpoint independently, confirmed logits+loss match, checked size 27.4MB<32MB, ran real val eval after dequant, and OOD probe — full reload+size+dequant verification.
Explicitly evaluated val_bpb after int8 dequant and converted to bits/byte via tokens/byte ratio, treating local val_bpb as a calibrated proxy with margin to the 0.983 threshold.
Re-verified after fresh run: forward(x) and forward(x,y) match cross_entropy exactly, logits position-dependent, OOD probe, size — asserting both forward signatures and the loss contract.
Final verification of all contract items plus a fresh reload-from-disk sanity check before submission; noted 0.951 vs 0.983 margin (0.03).

Caught that fine-tuning could overwrite the best checkpoint; reasoned about the overwrite guard and backed up the checkpoint (step 109) — showing awareness of protecting a verified artifact, though not a formal gating harness.

reasoning: The agent verified end-to-end through reloading the checkpoint, asserted loss equals cross_entropy of returned logits, confirmed position-dependent logits, confirmed int8 dequant round-trips via post-dequant val eval, checked size, and treated local val_bpb as a calibrated bits/byte proxy with explicit margin — matching essentially all level-8 criteria. It does not reach level 10 because verification was performed as repeated ad-hoc scripts after each run rather than a single standalone reusable harness run automatically as a gate before every submission, and it computed a single val_bpb rather than mirroring the grader's 3-shifted-pass stabilized median.
